title: Vicki P NDE 5261/3810
content:
5261 I had a bad cold, but no other known health problems. I was just a kid, about 8 years old. I was standing in the bathroom before the mirror and my mom was applying Vicks Vaporub to my chest. There was a very loud, almost electric-sounding buzzing sound that grew progressively louder. In the next moment, I was flying at a rapid rate through a tunnel, accompanied by pinpoints of very bright light, which I immediately recognized as angels... lots of angels. Then, I awoke to my mom slapping my face, shaking me, and screaming for my dad. In the first instant, I came to awareness, I remember being VERY angry that I was back here. I wanted to go on. It was so beautiful, peaceful, and the purest joy I have ever known. There has never been anything on earth to compare with the feeling. I was told that I had gone into a convulsion and my heart stopped. I was probably gone for about two to three minutes.
